items.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995
items.q: Basie and Duke was the only people that really kept steady bands at that time.

ctx.x: Of course. It was the band in the land. It was a great band, one of the greatest. And the respect that you get, was enormous. They were at the top of the heap at the time because Basie and Duke was the only people that really kept steady bands at that time. The rest of the bands would, for example Woody Herman or Stan Kenton, they would organize to make a tour, and then when the tour was over, this band would disband. But Basie stayed active all year around.
